goal: Generate 4 Genuine Student (GS) Responses for Australian Subclass 500 Visa. Each answer must be strictly under 150 words and evidence-backed.

structure.section: Question 1: Current circumstances (family, community, employment, assets)
structure.instruction: Give details of your current circumstances, including ties to family, community, employment, and assets.

structure.section: Question 2: Choice of course and provider in Australia
structure.instruction: Explain why you wish to study this course in Australia with this particular education provider (including your understanding of the requirements of the course, and study and living in Australia).

structure.section: Question 3: Value of course to future career opportunities
structure.instruction: Explain how completing this course will be of benefit to you, including your career plan back in your home country.
Give details of any other relevant information, such as your immigration history, gaps in study, or visa compliance.

structure_rules: Each response must be strictly under 150 words.
Formulate answers based strictly on facts present in the applicant fact-sheet.
Reference 3 to 6 months seasoned savings account details in Response 2.
red_flags: Vague, generic, or lifestyle-focused career plans
Undisclosed prior visa refusals or study gaps
Lack of reference to 3 to 6 months seasoned bank statement history in Response 2
quality_checklist: Each of the 4 answers is under 150 words
All claims are consistent with the applicant fact-sheet
